1use super::*;
2
3impl GameEnv {
4    pub(in crate::env) fn trigger_effect_id(
5        &self,
6        source_card: CardId,
7        effect_index: u8,
8    ) -> EffectId {
9        EffectId::new(EffectSourceKind::Trigger, source_card, 0, effect_index)
10    }
11
12    pub(in crate::env) fn compile_trigger_icon_effects(
13        &self,
14        icon: TriggerIcon,
15        ctx: TriggerCompileContext,
16    ) -> Vec<EffectSpec> {
17        match icon {
18            TriggerIcon::Soul => vec![EffectSpec {
19                id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_SOUL),
20                kind: EffectKind::ModifyPendingAttackDamage { delta: 1 },
21                target: None,
22                optional: false,
23            }],
24            TriggerIcon::Draw => vec![EffectSpec {
25                id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_DRAW),
26                kind: EffectKind::Draw { count: 1 },
27                target: None,
28                optional: false,
29            }],
30            TriggerIcon::Shot => vec![EffectSpec {
31                id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_SHOT),
32                kind: EffectKind::EnableShotDamage { amount: 1 },
33                target: None,
34                optional: false,
35            }],
36            TriggerIcon::Choice => Vec::new(),
37            TriggerIcon::Pool => vec![
38                EffectSpec {
39                    id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_POOL_MOVE),
40                    kind: EffectKind::MoveTriggerCardToStock,
41                    target: None,
42                    optional: false,
43                },
44                EffectSpec {
45                    id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_POOL_STOCK),
46                    kind: EffectKind::StockCharge { count: 1 },
47                    target: None,
48                    optional: false,
49                },
50            ],
51            TriggerIcon::Gate => vec![EffectSpec {
52                id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_GATE),
53                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
54                target: Some(TargetSpec {
55                    zone: TargetZone::WaitingRoom,
56                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
57                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
58                    card_type: Some(CardType::Climax),
59                    card_trait: None,
60                    level_max: None,
61                    cost_max: None,
62                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
63                    count: 1,
64                    limit: None,
65                    source_only: false,
66                    reveal_to_controller: false,
67                }),
68                optional: true,
69            }],
70            TriggerIcon::Bounce => vec![EffectSpec {
71                id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_BOUNCE),
72                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
73                target: Some(TargetSpec {
74                    zone: TargetZone::Stage,
75                    side: TargetSide::Opponent,
76                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
77                    card_type: Some(CardType::Character),
78                    card_trait: None,
79                    level_max: None,
80                    cost_max: None,
81                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
82                    count: 1,
83                    limit: None,
84                    source_only: false,
85                    reveal_to_controller: false,
86                }),
87                optional: true,
88            }],
89            TriggerIcon::Standby => {
90                let Some(slot) = ctx.standby_slot else {
91                    return Vec::new();
92                };
93                vec![EffectSpec {
94                    id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_STANDBY),
95                    kind: EffectKind::Standby { target_slot: slot },
96                    target: Some(TargetSpec {
97                        zone: TargetZone::WaitingRoom,
98                        side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
99                        slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
100                        card_type: Some(CardType::Character),
101                        card_trait: None,
102                        level_max: None,
103                        cost_max: None,
104                        card_ids: Vec::new(),
105                        count: 1,
106                        limit: None,
107                        source_only: false,
108                        reveal_to_controller: false,
109                    }),
110                    optional: false,
111                }]
112            }
113            TriggerIcon::Treasure => {
114                let Some(take_stock) = ctx.treasure_take_stock else {
115                    return Vec::new();
116                };
117                let mut effects = Vec::new();
118                if take_stock {
119                    // Stack is LIFO; enqueue move first so stock resolves before hand move.
120                    effects.push(EffectSpec {
121                        id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_TREASURE_MOVE),
122                        kind: EffectKind::MoveTriggerCardToHand,
123                        target: None,
124                        optional: false,
125                    });
126                    effects.push(EffectSpec {
127                        id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_TREASURE_STOCK),
128                        kind: EffectKind::TreasureStock { take_stock },
129                        target: None,
130                        optional: false,
131                    });
132                    return effects;
133                }
134                effects.push(EffectSpec {
135                    id: self.trigger_effect_id(ctx.source_card, TRIGGER_EFFECT_TREASURE_MOVE),
136                    kind: EffectKind::MoveTriggerCardToHand,
137                    target: None,
138                    optional: false,
139                });
140                effects
141            }
142        }
143    }
144}
